title: Plaintext User PII Stored in Unencrypted GetStorage
description: Sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII), including child profile records and national IDs, is written to GetX `GetStorage` (`box.write('user_pii', ...)`), which stores raw unencrypted JSON on disk.
attack_vector: Forensic extraction or malware with storage access reads the `GetStorage.gs` JSON container directly from the application document directory, exposing sensitive family and minor PII.
fix_rationale: Store sensitive PII in `FlutterSecureStorage` or encrypt the local storage payload with an AES-256-GCM key sealed inside Android Keystore / iOS Keychain.
